sites.name: Sanxingdui Museum and site
sites.what: Museum at the Sanxingdui site near Guanghan, Sichuan, known for its bronze masks and figures.

access.opening: Exhibition halls 8.30 am to 8 pm, last entry 6 pm; restoration hall 9 am to 6 pm
access.tickets: Real-name booking only through the museum's official website, WeChat or Douyin; foreign visitors book with a passport and bring the original. Weekday tickets release at 8 pm, up to 5 days ahead.

lore.text: Popular theories claim the bulging-eyed bronze masks depict visitors from another world or a lost civilisation.
lore.label: popular lore, not an official source

ancient-sites-and-mysteries.evidence: Official pages; read directly unless marked search snapshot.

laws.rule: Jiuzhaigou requires real-name advance booking (including free and concession tickets) on the 九寨沟旅游官方平台 WeChat mini program; in the 1 April to 15 November peak season up to 41,000 visitors a day, entry 7.30 am to 2 pm. Overnight stays inside the valley, smoking, open fires, wading or swimming, feeding fish or wildlife, picking plants and bringing pets are not allowed.
laws.heading: Jiuzhaigou Administration Bureau

laws.rule: Jiuzhaigou: peak season (1 April to 15 November) entrance ¥190 (about A$40.53 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) plus ¥90 park bus per adult, open 7:30am to 6pm; off-season ¥80 plus ¥80, 8:30am to 6pm. Optional insurance ¥10. Visitors must leave by 6pm and staying overnight inside the scenic area is strictly prohibited.
laws.heading: Jiuzhaigou

laws.rule: Chengdu: smoking, defined to include e-cigarette vapour and carrying a lit tobacco product, is banned indoors in public places. Outdoor bans cover children's venues, women's and children's hospitals, sports venue seating and play areas, heritage sites open to the public and crowded transport waiting areas (articles 2 and 6). A person who smokes in a banned place and ignores a request to stop is ordered to stop and fined (article 20).
laws.penalty_signal: Fine CNY 50 (about A$10.67); in serious cases CNY 100 to 200 (about A$21.33 to A$42.66). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)

laws.rule: Chengdu: setting off fireworks is banned in the Jinjiang, Qingyang, Jinniu, Wuhou and Chenghua districts and within 500 metres outside the Ring Expressway in other districts (article 3).
laws.penalty_signal: Fine CNY 100 to 500 (about A$21.33 to A$107) (article 11). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
